claims.claim: Brain Context and the Flow Card registry recognize RESEARCH as one explicit-only BRAIN flow while preserving pending canonical obligations and the six existing flow contracts.

AIOS_RESEARCH_PACKET v1 binds the Work Context fingerprint, validated Brief and profile, optional validated record fingerprint, declared basis fingerprint, and RA-3 reuse projection in a bounded content-addressed packet.
A RESEARCH FlowResolution is rejected by the existing Decision Packet compiler; the Brain return-contract and BrainProvider semantic modules were not changed.
The separate ResearchProvider surface invokes one explicitly supplied provider once, keeps attribution outside the semantic return, derives returns through RA-5, and exposes bounded typed failures.

Conformance tests reconstruct packet identity from fresh equivalent context and demonstrate that provider substitution preserves request identity while valid differing audit conclusions produce different return identities.
Conformance tests bind source substitution to Research Record identity and exercise RA-3 reuse and exact refresh projections from caller-supplied basis identities.

AIOS_RESEARCH_ARCHITECTURE_HANDOFF v1 projects bounded Brief, closure, assessment, and material-claim content only from a validated public RESEARCH_CANDIDATE record, excluding source excerpts and lifecycle commands.

The commit changes only the seven permitted files; it adds no engineering lifecycle, automatic TASK progression, live provider or source integration, or changes to RA-1 through RA-5 or the Kernel pipeline.
